<!-- The category, e.g. physics logic, low-quality 3D rendering, data/catalog pipeline, etc -->

<!-- Screenshots help a lot. -->

<!-- Steps, settings, or parameters used (mass, spin, inclination, etc.) -->

<!-- The files involved, including paths. -->
**Affected profiles:**

<!-- Aetherion version or commit #; use OS, GPU and driver if it's a rendering issue as well -->

<!-- Best guesses for reasons clearly documented as guesses. This includes dead ends. -->

<!-- Possible solutions to issue, may be in detail. If it's a guess, please say so. -->
